If a Fairphone product doesn’t work out in the EU, your main options are:

Return: Direct-shop purchases can be returned within 14 days of delivery for a refund of the purchase price and delivery costs. Use the Self-Service Return Portal, email, or post. Returns are free, although user damage may result in charges.

Faulty or damaged item: Use the Return Request Portal to troubleshoot and create a shipping label. After inspection, a manufacturing defect may qualify for replacement.

Warranty: Standard coverage is 2 years; some models qualify for extended coverage. Covered repairs are free.

Repair or self-repair: Request repairs through the self-service portal, or purchase spare parts for eligible devices. Out-of-warranty costs depend on parts, labour, shipping, and your country.
